answers.question: Cancellation gets no answer: If the cancel call itself gets no answer, so the agent does not know whether the order was cancelled, what should it do?
answers.recommended: the agent does not retry the cancellation blindly; it re-reads the order: if it is cancelled, it goes on to the refund; if it is still placed or processing, it tells the customer the cancellation did not go through and issues no refund; if the re-read also fails, it tells the customer the cancellation status is unknown, issues no refund, and hands the order to store staff for follow-up.
answers.reply:
> Q4 If the cancel call times out: no blind resend; re-read the order. Cancelled, continue to refund. Still placed or processing, send the cancel once more under the same confirmation. Shipped, report it and issue no refund. Re-read fails, say outcome unknown, issue no refund, hand off.
> Reads may be retried on timeout without limit; only commit calls are bounded.
